articles.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co. (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today introduced the Vertiv™ PowerStation 3100 RPP, a high-density remote power panel designed to help data center operators streamline power distribution for AI and high-performance computing (HPC) racks with power densities exceeding 100 kW. The solution is available now in North America.

articles.summary: At megawatt-scale rack densities, the problem is conductor volume. 800 VDC addresses this, but voltage alone is not an architecture. The real design variable is where the AC-to-DC conversion boundary sits and how that choice shapes fault domains, battery integration, and operational complexity.
